records.applicationTiming: Banded at sowing; N top-dressed at GS30-GS31 per season.
records.applicationMethod: Band MAP/DAP with or below the seed. Top-dress N based on seasonal rainfall at GS30-GS31. Calculate N from target yield and deep-soil N test.
records.notes: N 40-80; P2O5 20-35; K2O 15-25 kg/ha. Dryland rainfed wheat.
records.source_title: Crop nutrition fact sheets — wheat (dryland rainfed)

records.applicationMethod: Band all fertilizer at sowing. Avoid excessive post-tillering N on malting barley (grain protein).
records.notes: N 35-65; P2O5 20-30; K2O 15-20 kg/ha. Feed/malting barley.

records.applicationTiming: All at sowing; or N top-dressed after winter grazing.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all fertilizer at sowing, or top-dress N after winter grazing.

records.applicationTiming: P/K/S at sowing; N split at rosette/bud stage.
records.applicationMethod: Apply P2O5, K2O and sulphur at sowing. Split N with a top-dress at rosette/bud stage.
No N needed — high N2 fixation. Band P2O5 and K2O below the seed; lupins are sensitive to seed-contact fertilizer damage.
records.notes: N 0 (N-fixing); P2O5 20-35; K2O 25-40 kg/ha. Narrow-leafed lupins.

records.applicationTiming: Banded at sowing with Rhizobium inoculant.
records.applicationMethod: Starter N only if soil is cold (0-10 kg/ha). Band P2O5 and K2O at sowing with Rhizobium inoculant.
records.notes: N 0-10 (starter); P2O5 20-30; K2O 15-20 kg/ha. Desi/Kabuli chickpea.

records.applicationTiming: Pre-plant deep-banded N; starter P in furrow.
records.applicationMethod: Deep-band N pre-plant. Place starter P in the furrow.
records.notes: N 60-110; P2O5 20-35; K2O 15-30 kg/ha. Northern NSW & QLD.

records.applicationTiming: 40% N + full P/K pre-plant banded; 60% N water-run at squaring/early flower.
records.applicationMethod: Pre-plant banded: 40% of N plus full P2O5 and K2O. Apply the remaining 60% of N as water-run urea during squaring/early flower. High-yielding irrigated target 10-12 bales/ha.
records.notes: N 180-240; P2O5 40-60; K2O 60-100 kg/ha. Irrigated, 10-12 bales/ha target.

records.applicationTiming: Pre-flood drill or aerial top-dress at panicle initiation.
records.applicationMethod: Drill all fertilizer pre-flood under permanent water, or aerial top-dress at panicle initiation.
records.notes: N 120-180; P2O5 35-50; K2O 25-35 kg/ha. Murrumbidgee/Murray Valley.

records.applicationTiming: Surface banded in stool after harvest or at planting.
records.applicationMethod: Surface-band in the stool following harvest or at planting, per the SIX EASY STEPS method.
records.notes: N 130-160; P2O5 20-40; K2O 80-120 kg/ha. Wet Tropics & Burdekin QLD.

records.applicationTiming: Pre-plant banded or split at planting + button stage.
records.applicationMethod: Pre-plant banded, or split between planting and button stage.

records.applicationTiming: Below seed at sowing with Group F inoculant.
records.applicationMethod: Minimal N (0-5 kg/ha). Place P2O5 and K2O below the seed with Group F inoculant.
records.notes: N 0-5; P2O5 20-30; K2O 15-20 kg/ha. Southern region lentil.
